chats.answer:
For a laptop screen extender under $300, I'd prioritize a 1080p IPS display, USB-C connectivity, a stable mounting system, and compatibility with your laptop.

There are two main types:

Attachable screen extenders: Clip onto your laptop and add one or two screens. Best for working while traveling.

Standalone portable monitors: Sit beside your laptop with a kickstand. Usually offer better value, less weight on your laptop, and better ergonomics.

If you specifically want a screen that attaches to your laptop, here are the models I'd consider.

What I'd choose

For one additional screen, I'd pick the UPERFECT 14-inch 2K. For two additional screens, I'd choose the UPERFECT dual 14-inch model, provided your laptop supports two external displays.

One important compatibility warning: some base-model Apple Silicon MacBooks support only one external monitor natively. A triple-screen extender may require DisplayLink hardware and software.
